summary: Two clients on one instrument: an LTP holder, then a Quote holder moves Kite's mode to quote; one quote packet serves both, each at its mode; the Quote holder leaving moves Kite back to ltp, and the last one leaving unsubscribes.

notes: Worked by hand from zerodha_adapter.py:530-559 (a quote tick is published on the QUOTE topic, and an LTP copy is published when mode 1 is held).

deviations.reason: Whether and how a frame carries ltt (in LTP frames, or beside the broker's own trade-time name) follows the web's Zerodha adapter; the desktop always sends ltt in ms. Lead rule 2026-11-09: this follows each broker's own web adapter (lane wire's per-broker dialect switch; bk-a sets the entry in phase B).
deviations.ref: tests/it/feed_conformance.rs (the ltt tolerance); zerodha_adapter.py:549; lead rule 2026-11-09
